༄༅/ /rta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang bskur bsdus pa gtor ma la brten pa'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga dbang chen thugs kyi snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang bskur bsdus pa gtor ma la brten pa'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga dbang chen thugs kyi snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dang dpal dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ khams gsum dbang du mdzad pa dang*// bdud dpung zil gyis gnon byed pa// dbang chen lha mchog der btud nas// dbang bzhi gcig rdzogs tshul 'di bkod//

rta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang chog rin chen gter bum las gtor ma la brten nas dbang bzhi gdan thog gcig tu bskur ba la/ sbyor ba dkyil 'khor ras bris sam/ maṇ+ḍal la lha grangs kyi tshom bu bkod pa'i khar mañdzi'i khri la rin po che'i snod du gtor ma ri rab bang rim bzhi brtsegs gru bzhi pa/ de'i steng du zlum po/ de steng pad bskor/ de steng dpal gtor zur gsum ngos gsum la rin po che dang zur gsum la pad+mas brgyan cing phyi skor pad 'dab brgyad kyis bskor ba/ dkar thig dmar rgyan gyis spras shing dar gur dmar po dang bcas pa bsham/ mdun du sku tsaka /sgrub yig /phyag mtshan phyogs bsdus kyi tsaka li rnams dang*/ g.yas g.yon du sman raka /phyi mchod phreng tshar du bsham/ bhan+dhar bdud rtsi dang sin+dhu ra/ las bum/ gtor tshogs sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad tshogs par bya'o// dngos gzhi gzhung las/ las gzhung bsrangs la dbang gi rdzong bca': zhes gsungs pas skyabs sems bgegs gtor btang ba sngon du 'gro bas/ las byang rin chen phreng ba ltar bka' bsgo nas brtsam lha bskyed skabs bdag dang gtor ma lha'i dkyil 'khor du gsal/ bzlas pa'i skabs su'ang sngags kyi 'phro 'du bya/ stong tshig dang dngos grub blang ba'i rjes su dbang bskur yang chog la/ rgyas par spro na srung ma'i gtor 'bul dang tshogs bsgral bstab kyi bar du gtang*/

las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bskyed bzlas byas la/ slob ma rnams khrus nas dbyung*/ bgegs gtong btang zhing las byang ltar bka' bsgo /srung 'khor bsgom/ me tog bkye bsdu dang sems bskyed gsal btab nas/

de la 'dir bcom ldan 'das dpal pad+ma dbang chen nyid grub pa'i skyes bu chen po'i skur bzhengs pa/ slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis rta mgrin dmar nag gi rgyud dang gdams ngag gi bka' srol mtha' yas pa bod yul gyi las can rnams la bstsal par mdzad pa las thugs dam yang zab kyi chos sde/ lho gter rin chen 'bras bu'i snying po/ dam chos 'dus pa skor bzhi'i ya gyal/ rta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa la smin byed kyi dbang bskur rgyas bsdus gnyis su bzhugs pa las 'dir yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i dbang gi snying po byin rlabs thod rgal du 'beb pa'i gnad mchog /dpal gyi gtor ma la brten nas dbang bzhi gdan thog gcig tu rdzogs par byed pa nyid bsgrub par bgyi ba la bdag nyid kyis bya ba'i rim pa song ba yin cing*/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du zhing khams 'bul ba zhu/
zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul gzhug /
thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ bde chen pad+ma gar gyi bdag: he ru ka dpal mchog chen po: dpa' bo khyod kyis bdag rjes bzung: dbang gis smin par mdzad du gsol:
lan gsum/

de ltar gsol ba btab pas snod rung du gyur pa la slar yang skal pa brtag cing dam tshig gi nges gnas 'dri ba 'di la snyan gtod 'tshal/ dbang gi dkyil 'khor bla med 'dir: spyir yang 'jug pa'i snod ldan dkon: khyed cag dam la gnas nus sam: zhes dris pa'i lan btab par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos/ gal te lus dang srog la sogs: bya dga' che la thug gyur kyang: bdag ni dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung: bka' bzhin rjes su bsgrub par spro:
slob dpon gyis rdo rje gdengs shing*/
de ltar yin na dbang chen gyi: dal du gzhug cing smin par bya: bla med gsang ba'i dbang mchog 'di: gnas khang 'di yi phyi rol du: smra ru mi rung bro bor cig:
rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/

rdo rje'i tha tshig bro bor ba 'di'i rjes zlos/ badz+ra rak+ṣa sī hūm̐: sa ma ya i dan na ra kan: bla ma dang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor tha dad med pa dbang chen 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor la dkon mchog rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor te bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ bdag gzhan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad byang chub ma thob kyi bar du snying thag pa nas skyabs su mchi'o snyam pa'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos/ na mo: bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: bdag dang 'gro ba sems can rnams: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi:
lan gsum/

thabs khyad par du gyur pa gsag sbyang yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin du bya ba'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos/ rang rig lha la phyag 'tshal lo: ma 'gags rang gsal mchod pa 'bul: mu bzhir ltung ba mthol lo bshags: dus gsum mnyam nyid rjes yi rang: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par bskul: ka dag zang thal rjen par bzhugs: kun kyang rang rig rtogs par bsngo: sku gsum yongs rdzogs thob par shog:
gsum mam gcig /

mkha' khyab kyi skye dgu thams cad dpal pad+ma dbang chen gyi go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du smin byed zab mo gsan la grol byed lam gyi rim pa nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa dang*/ tshad med bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin la blo bzhag bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye ma bdag gis 'gro kun bsgral bya'i phyir: rta mgrin dbang gi dkyil 'khor du: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par bskul: tshad med bzhi ru sems bskyed do:
lan gsum/

de nas dbang bskur dngos gzhi'i slad du yid rtse gcig pas dmigs 'dun 'di bzhin mdzad par zhu/ stong pa'i ngang las snod kyi 'jig rten dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su dregs pa nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis dbang chen rta mgrin sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas gri gug dang g.yon pas thod khrag bsnams pa/ spyan bsgrad zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs shing sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'bar ba/ ral pa kham ser spyi bor bcings shing sku rgyab khebs par gtibs pa/ spyi bo nas rta skad thengs gsum 'jig rten g.yo bar 'tsher ba/ glang chen mi lpags stag sham sbrul chun la sogs dur khrod kyi chas rnams rdzogs pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo mthing nag gri thod bsnams shing dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs pa/ spyi bor phag zhal ngur sgra sgrog pa dang gnyis med du 'khril ba/ me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na zhabs brkyang bskum 'gying bag dang ldan pa zhig tu gsal thobs shig /dpal gyi gtor ma 'di'ang khyed rang gis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i dbang chen rta mgrin yum dang bcas pa'i/ sku gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can du gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa dang/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas bde chen pad+ma 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i lha tshogs kyi thugs rgyud bskul/

gtso 'khor thams cad rta skad du 'tsher/ phag skad du ngur/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hrīḥhrīḥ pheṃ pheṃ/ khro bo'i rta skad du ti ri ri byon nas khyed rang rnams la dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub bstsal/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar thim pas sku'i byin rlabs lus la zhugs par mos shig /hūm̐: dbang chen khro rgyal he ru ka: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs mchog gsang ba'i rgyal: sku yi dkyil 'khor chen po nas: skal ldan lus la dbang bzhi skur: dbang chen sku yi dbang thob shog: oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba bha rā hī kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ:
gtor ma dpral bar bzhag /

yang gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim pas gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la zhugs par mos shig /hūm̐: dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor nas: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsung gi dbang: skal ldan ngag la bskur ba yis: dbang chen gsung gi dbang thob shog:
gong gi rtsa sngags sham bur
wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā:
gtor ma mgrin par bzhag /

yang gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas thugs kyi byin rlabs yid la zhugs par mos shig /hūm̐: dbang chen thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs kyi dbang: skal ldan yid la dbang bskur bas: dbang chen thugs kyi dbang thob shog:
rtsa sngags sham bur
tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/
gtor ma snying gar bzhag /

yang gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i lte ba nas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lte bar thim pas gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs yongs rdzogs rgyud la zhugs par mos shig /hūm̐: dbang chen sku gsung thugs yon tan: phrin las 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: skal ldan lus ngag yid gsum la: dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob par shog:
rtsa sngags sham bur
sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī:
gtor ma lte bar bzhag /

de dag rnams kyis dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ sgrib pa bzhi sbyang*/ rgyud bzhi smin/ lam bzhi bsgom pa la dbang*/ sku bzhi thob pa'i skal pa can du gyur pa yin no// de'i rjes 'brel du sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa yin pas/ thog mar sku'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ khyed rang dbang chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i sku snang stong chu zla lta bur sgoms shig /
gtso bo'i sku spyi bor bzhag la/
bskyed rim gsal la 'dzin pa med: dbang chen bskyed rim yengs med bsgom: dbang chen sku dang dbyer med sbyor: yi dam lha yi sku thob shog:
dpral bar sin+dhu ra'i thig le bya/
bzlas pa las kyi sngags grags stong chu bo'i rgyun lta bur zlos shig /
rtsa sngags sham bu bcas brjod la lag tu bdud rtsi sbyin/ sgrub yig snying gar bzhag la/
bsnyen cing sgrub pa las sbyor tshul: chu bo'i rgyun bzhin drag tu zlos: dbang gi gsung dang dbyer med par: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob shog:
mgrin par thig le bya/
'od gsal thugs kyi dgongs pa rig stong nam mkha' sprin bral lta bu'i ngang du mnyam par zhog cig /
phyag mtshan lag tu gtad la/
hūm̐: thugs ni mi 'gyur ye shes sems: gnas 'gyur dag pa ye shes sems: dbang chen thugs dang dbyer med sbyor: khro rgyal thugs kyi dbang thob shog:
snying gar thig le gdab/

de dag gis gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang gi cho ga rin chen gter bum rdzogs par grub pa yin pas/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig legs par bsrung zhing dbang chen rta mchog yi dam gyi lhar bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar

sogs dbang gi rjes rim spyi ltar bya/ tshogs yod na tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma gtang ba man chad las byang gi dkyus bzhin gtang*/ tshogs med na/ mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ shis pa brjod pas mthar dbyung ngo*// byin rlabs thod rgal 'beb pa'i gnad// spros bcas dbang gi snying po 'dis// 'gro kun smin pa'i skal bzang ldan// dbang chen phyag rgya che 'grub shog /ces ngo mtshar byin rlabs kyi snying po 'di nyid ngo mtshar mdzod kyi cha rkyen du pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal gyis tsa 'dra rin chen brag gi dben gnas su bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel// //
